papers.title: Numerical and experimental investigation of laser remelting in selective laser melting of 316L stainless steel
papers.venue: CIRP journal of manufacturing science and technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究SLM激光重熔工艺对316L不锈钢的影响，与增材制造生物医学方向仅工艺层面相关，未涉及植入物力学或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses laser remelting process optimization for 316L stainless steel with no porous implant design, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, and no biomedical or osseointegration context.

summary_zh.motivation: 激光重熔可改善SLM成形件表面质量与致密度，但工艺-性能关系尚需量化。
summary_zh.method: 结合数值模拟与实验，研究激光重熔对SLM 316L不锈钢温度场、表面形貌及力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 重熔工艺参数显著影响表面粗糙度与致密度，优化参数下成形质量提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SLM实验样件的表面形貌与力学性能测试进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Laser remelting offers a route to improve surface quality and density of SLM parts, yet the process-property relationships require quantification.
summary_en.method: A combined numerical and experimental study investigates how laser remelting parameters affect the thermal field, surface morphology, and mechanical properties of SLM 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.result: Remelting parameters markedly influence surface roughness and densification, with optimized settings yielding improved as-built quality.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through surface morphology characterization and mechanical testing of SLM-fabricated specimens.

papers.title: Deep residual physics-informed neural network for underwater electric potential reconstruction

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文将残差物理信息神经网络用于水下电场重构，方法可迁移至FEA代理建模，但应用域与生物医学植入物无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical or implant mechanics context, no FEA surrogate benchmark, and no uncertainty quantification; it targets underwater electric field reconstruction rather than solid-mechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 水下电场重构受限于传统数值方法计算成本高。
summary_zh.method: 构建深度残差物理信息神经网络，将残差连接与物理约束结合求解电场。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真场景中实现电场重构，精度优于基线方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于数值仿真案例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Reconstructing underwater electric potentials is computationally demanding for conventional numerical solvers.
summary_en.method: A deep residual physics-informed neural network is developed that embeds governing physics with residual connections to reconstruct electric potential fields.
summary_en.result: The proposed network achieves improved reconstruction accuracy over baseline approaches in simulated scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical simulation cases of underwater electric fields.

papers.title: A novel chatter-resistant boring bar design with lattice structure and non-Newtonian fluid

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究车削镗杆的颤振抑制，与增材制造生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses machine-tool chatter suppression via a lattice-filled boring bar, with no biomedical implant context, no LPBF fabrication of implants, no osseointegration, and no bone-implant mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 抑制深孔镗削加工中的颤振以提高加工稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 设计含晶格结构与剪切增稠非牛顿流体的复合镗杆。
summary_zh.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体减振效果与量化指标。
summary_zh.validation: 摘要缺失，验证方式未知。

summary_en.motivation: To suppress regenerative chatter during deep-hole boring operations and improve machining stability.
summary_en.method: A composite boring bar integrating a lattice structure with a non-Newtonian shear-thickening fluid is proposed.
summary_en.result: The abstract is missing, so the reported damping performance and quantitative outcomes cannot be confirmed.
summary_en.validation: Validation approach is unknown because no abstract was provided.

papers.title: Deep Vein Thrombosis Risk Prediction after Total Hip Replacement at Kandou Hospital
papers.abstract: Deep vein thrombosis (DVT) is a clinically significant complication following total hip arthroplasty (THA), requiring a clear distinction between observed postoperative events and model-based risk estimates. This prospective cohort study enrolled 62 patients who underwent THA at Prof. Dr. R. D. Kandou Hospital in Manado, Indonesia, between January 2023 and December 2024, with a 90-day follow-up period. Clinical characteristics, Wells scores, D-dimer levels, fibrinogen levels, and Doppler ultrasonography findings were recorded. Descriptive findings indicated that 46 participants (74%) were male, 48 (77%) had elevated D-dimer levels, and all documented Doppler ultrasonography examinations yielded normal findings. A Monte Carlo simulation comprising 10,000 iterations was also performed using a logistic regression equation with coefficients reportedly derived from published literature rather than estimated from the study cohort. The simulation yielded a median predicted DVT prevalence of 7.3%, with a 95% prediction interval of 0%–29%. However, this estimate represented a simulation-derived outcome rather than the observed incidence of postoperative DVT. The available manuscript did not report the actual number of incident DVT events during the 90-day follow-up and contained an unresolved inconsistency between the exclusion of patients with active cancer and the reported inclusion of seven participants with active cancer. [AUTHOR DATA REQUIRED: Confirm the number of observed DVT events during follow-up and clarify the eligibility criteria concerning active cancer.] Overall, the study provided descriptive information on clinical characteristics and potential DVT risk factors in a local THA population, alongside an exploratory simulation-based risk estimation framework. Nevertheless, cohort-specific predictive associations, model discrimination, and calibration could not be established without verification of the observed clinical outcomes, model coefficients, and estimation procedures.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文为全髋置换术后深静脉血栓的临床风险预测研究，与股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或骨-假体界面力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is a clinical DVT risk-prediction cohort study with Monte Carlo simulation; it contains no finite element modeling, no femoral stem stress-shielding or micromotion quantification, no Gruen zone strain analysis, and no bone-implant contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 全髋置换术后深静脉血栓风险需区分实际事件与模型估计。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性队列纳入62例患者，记录Wells评分、D-二聚体、纤维蛋白原及多普勒超声，并用文献系数的logistic方程做蒙特卡洛模拟。
summary_zh.result: 模拟预测DVT中位患病率7.3%，但实际随访事件数未报告，且癌症纳入标准存在矛盾。
summary_zh.validation: 临床队列随访与模拟预测，缺乏模型区分度和校准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Postoperative deep vein thrombosis after total hip arthroplasty requires clear separation between observed events and model-based risk estimates.
summary_en.method: A prospective cohort of 62 THA patients was followed for 90 days with clinical characteristics, Wells scores, D-dimer, fibrinogen, and Doppler ultrasound, supplemented by a 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo simulation using literature-derived logistic coefficients.
summary_en.result: The simulation produced a median predicted DVT prevalence of 7.3% with a 95% prediction interval of 0%-29%, yet the observed incident event count was not reported and cancer eligibility criteria were inconsistent.
summary_en.validation: Clinical cohort follow-up combined with simulation-based risk estimation, without established model discrimination or calibration.

papers.title: Experimental Study and Physics-Informed Machine Learning on Sustainable Concrete Using Sugarcane Bagasse Ash and Distilled Sewage Water
papers.abstract: The increasing environmental burden associated with cement production and freshwater consumption has created a need for sustainable alternatives in concrete production. This study investigates the combined utilization of Sugarcane Bagasse Ash (SCBA) as a partial cement replacement and Distilled SewageWater (DSW) as an alternative mixing-water source in M25–grade concrete. Seven concrete mixtures (M0–M6) were prepared by incorporating 0–30% SCBA and 0–40% DSW while maintaining a constant binder content of 400 kg/m3 and water-to-binder ratio of 0.50. Compressive strength was experimentally evaluated after 7, 14, and 28 days of curing. The results demonstrated that moderate replacement levels improved strength, with the mixture containing 10% SCBA and 20% DSW achieving the highest compressive strengths of 20.8, 26.1, and 34.2 MPa at 7, 14, and 28 days, respectively. The improvement was attributed to the pozzolanic activity and micro-filler effect of SCBA, together with adequate water availability. Higher replacement levels resulted in strength reduction because of cement dilution and reduced calcium hydroxide availability. Furthermore, Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) models were developed to predict compressive strength using key mix–design parameters and curing age. Both models exhibited excellent predictive performance, with R2 values exceeding 0.999 during the evaluated stages. ANN provided slightly higher numerical accuracy, whereas PINN demonstrated more consistent validation and testing behaviour, indicating improved generalisation and physical consistency. The findings demonstrate that the integrated experimental, physics-informed modelling, and explainable–AI framework can support the development and optimization of sustainable SCBA–DSW concrete while reducing dependence on conventional cement and freshwater resources.
papers.venue: Journal of the Civil Engineering Forum

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN用于混凝土强度预测，属于FEA代理模型方向的弱相关应用，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA simulation, no surrogate for expensive solid-mechanics simulation, no implant/biomechanics context, and no uncertainty quantification—only point-prediction ANN/PINN on concrete strength data.

summary_zh.motivation: 为降低水泥与淡水消耗，探索甘蔗渣灰与蒸馏污水在混凝土中的联合替代。
summary_zh.method: 制备七组M25混凝土，测试7/14/28天抗压强度，并建立ANN与PINN预测模型。
summary_zh.result: 10%SCBA与20%DSW组合强度最高，ANN精度略优而PINN泛化与物理一致性更好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验室抗压强度试验与模型R2对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: The study seeks sustainable concrete alternatives to reduce cement production and freshwater consumption.
summary_en.method: Seven M25 concrete mixes with varying sugarcane bagasse ash and distilled sewage water were cast, tested for compressive strength, and modeled with ANN and PINN predictors.
summary_en.result: The 10% SCBA and 20% DSW mix achieved the highest strengths, while ANN showed slightly better accuracy and PINN better generalization and physical consistency.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compressive strength testing at 7, 14, and 28 days was used to validate the machine learning predictions.

papers.title: Application and Performance Evaluation of a Physics-Informed Neural Network for Transformer Insulation Paper Degradation Prediction
papers.venue: The Transactions of The Korean Institute of Electrical Engineers

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息神经网络用于变压器绝缘纸降解预测，属于PINN在电力设备老化领域的应用，与用户的FEA代理建模方向仅有方法层面的弱关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper applies PINN to power-transformer insulation paper degradation with no FEA surrogate benchmarking, no solid-mechanics or implant context, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 变压器绝缘纸老化评估依赖耗时实验，需快速预测手段。
summary_zh.method: 构建物理信息神经网络，将降解动力学约束嵌入损失函数进行预测。
summary_zh.result: 在绝缘纸降解数据上评估了PINN的预测性能。
summary_zh.validation: 基于绝缘纸降解数据的数值评估，无实验或临床验证。

summary_en.motivation: Rapid assessment of transformer insulation paper aging is needed because conventional experimental evaluation is time-consuming.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network is constructed with degradation-kinetics constraints embedded in the loss function for prediction.
summary_en.result: The predictive performance of the PINN is evaluated on insulation paper degradation data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical evaluation on insulation paper degradation data without experimental or clinical validation.
